scope: Reconstruct only the later 25 September 2026 issuer snapshot at configured target weights. Historical annual-report schedules and Dimensional holdings remain separate.

measurement.identifier: strip ticker + name + market currency; exact case; no ISIN reconciliation
measurement.overlap: sum of smaller matched fund weights; no equity renormalization
measurement.portfolio_weights: source fund weights times configured target sleeve weights
measurement.factor_exposures: supplied rounded Exposure Breakdowns including cash/derivatives

interpretation.calendar: After the main 28 August 2026 cutoff, not historical attribution.
interpretation.matching: Security-line proxy, not a consolidated issuer or reconciled ISIN master. Ticker/name/currency variations can understate overlap; listings/classes remain separate.
interpretation.denominator: Weights are shares of fund NAV times target sleeve allocations, not equity-renormalized or levered shares of initial investor capital.
interpretation.classifications: Core equity-only country/sector sums differ in scope from rounded factor Exposure Breakdowns including cash and derivatives. Missing equity classifications are not filled.
interpretation.history: Four synchronized later ETF snapshots only; older annual-report schedules and Dimensional remain separately dated evidence. Does not explain past performance or establish future diversification.
